name: truck_set_params
description: Change the RC truck's design; the truck on the course drives differently at once (physics from the design: top speed from motor kV x battery / gearing / wheel size, launch from push / mass limited by grip, turn radius from wheelbase / tan(steering lock), and the cornering limit: past the tyres' grip it slides wide, and a high, narrow truck rolls over in a fast tight turn). Give only the values to change. The result says what changed in driving: tell the person that. Set save_version true to save it as a new version of the truck (a project version in the notebook); reset 'stock' or 'saved' first goes back to the stock truck or the last saved version. It is a simulated truck, so no confirmation is needed. Use it when the person asks to make the truck faster, grippier, wider, taller, lighter, to change its motor, battery, wheels or steering, or to save or reset the design.

wheelbase_mm.description: Front axle to rear axle, 120 to 280 mm (stock 170). Longer turns wider.

track_mm.description: Left wheel centre to right, 110 to 220 mm (stock 144). Wider is harder to roll over.

wheel_diameter_mm.description: Tyre diameter, 50 to 110 mm (stock 68). Bigger is faster but pushes less and lifts the truck.

ride_height_mm.description: Ground to chassis, 10 to 60 mm (stock 21). Higher tips over sooner.

steer_deg.description: Steering lock at full lock, 20 to 45 degrees (stock 35). More turns tighter.

tyre_grip.description: Tyre friction coefficient, 0.5 (hard plastic) to 1.6 (soft foam), stock 1.1 (rubber).

motor_kv.description: Motor rpm per volt, 1000 to 4500 (stock 2000). More is faster flat out, less push off the line.

battery_cells.description: LiPo cells, 1 to 4 (stock 2 = 7.4 V), 45 g each. More is faster and heavier.

mass_g.description: Chassis and body without the battery, 250 to 1500 g (stock 460). Heavier speeds up slower.

reset.description: Before applying the values: 'stock' for the stock truck, 'saved' for the last saved version.

save_version.description: True to save the result as a new truck version (and project version).

name: truck_design_show
description: Open (or close) the Truck design panel: sliders for the truck's wheelbase, track, wheels, ride height, steering, tyre grip, motor, battery and mass, a live readout of how it drives, Save as version and Reset. Use it when the person wants to see or edit the truck's design.

on.description: True to open (default), false to close.

name: truck_describe
description: Read the RC truck's current design and how it drives: every parameter, the derived top speed, acceleration, stopping distance, turn radius, grip and roll-over limits, the fastest it can hold full lock and whether it slides or rolls over past it, the saved version and whether it was edited since, the recent saved versions, and whether the trained autopilot learned on a different design. Use it when the person asks about the truck's design, why it slid or rolled over, or what a change would do.
